CustomField.description: System Doctor async Apex capacity thresholds in percent, as "warn,crit" (example: 80,95). Degraded at warn. Critical at crit. Rule: 0 < warn < crit <= 100. Blank or not valid text uses 80,95.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Example: 80,95. Degraded at the first value. Critical at the second value.
CustomField.label: Async Capacity Thresholds
